Method of Attack: Remote code execution exploiting CVE-2018-1000049 to hijack devices running Claymore mining software
Reconfiguring compromised devices to join 'dwarfpool' mining pool and use attacker's ETH wallet
Discoverer: Johannes B. Ullrich of SANS ISC
Attack Vector: Mass scanning for exposed port 3333 used by mining equipment
Exploitation of remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2018-1000049
Indicators of Compromise: Scanning activity from about 17k independent IP addresses mainly from Uninet SA de CV, telmex.com in Mexico
Compromised GPON routers used to scan and deploy exploits
